# registry_audit_log (Data Source)

Fetches a single audit log entry by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_audit_log" "entry" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "audit_actor" {
  value = data.registry_audit_log.entry.user_email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the audit log entry to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action performed (e.g. 'create', 'update', 'delete').
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of the event.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the requester.
- `metadata_json` (String) Additional metadata serialised as JSON.
- `organization_id` (String) UUID of the organization context.
- `resource_id` (String) UUID of the affected resource.
- `resource_type` (String) Type of resource affected.
- `user_email` (String) Email of the user who performed the action.
- `user_id` (String) UUID of the user who performed the action.
- `user_name` (String) Display name of the user.
